career_ladder.note: Executive Trainees at NTPC undergo 1 year of institutional and on-the-job training before absorption into the permanent executive cadre in IDA Grade E-2 as Assistant Manager / Engineer, progressing through merit-cum-seniority promotions.

steps.source_label: NTPC Engineering Executive Trainees Recruitment Notification (Advt. No. 05/2024)
NTPC Executive Service Rules (Absorption & Cadre Norms)

exam_scheme.note: Selection of Executive Trainees is based on valid normalized GATE scores in the respective engineering discipline followed by Document Verification, or a composite evaluation including Group Discussion and Personal Interview.

stages.source_label: NTPC Advt. No. 05/2024 Selection Process (GATE Paper Codes: EE, ME, EC, IN, CE, MN)

papers.paper_name: GATE Examination in Corresponding Engineering Discipline
papers.negative_marking: Per GATE standard marking scheme (-0.33 for 1-mark MCQs, -0.66 for 2-mark MCQs)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit rank cut-off based on 1:5 ratio per vacancy

stages.stage_name: Stage 2: Document Verification & Pre-Employment Medical Examination
stages.source_label: NTPC Medical Guidelines and Verification Process

papers.qualifying_threshold: Fulfillment of educational qualifications, category certificate authenticity, and medical standards

financial_package.note: Executive Trainees receive basic pay of ₹40,000 in IDA Grade E-1 during training, plus 58% IDA constant as of 2025-07-01, company accommodation or HRA, and cafeteria perks (35%). On regularisation in E-2, basic pay advances to ₹50,000.
financial_package.pay_level: IDA Pay Scale Grade E-1 during training (₹40,000 – ₹1,40,000); Grade E-2 on absorption (₹50,000 – ₹1,60,000)
financial_package.pay_source_label: NTPC Compensation Structure for Engineering Executive Trainees
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated with training Basic Pay ₹40,000, 58% IDA (₹23,200), HRA (up to 27% = ₹10,800), and Cafeteria Perks @ 35% (₹14,000), less statutory deductions for PF and Group Insurance.
official_perks: Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) indexed to quarterly AICPI
Company township accommodation or House Rent Allowance (HRA)
Perks & allowances under cafeteria approach up to 35% of basic pay
Performance Related Pay (PRP) linked to NTPC MoU targets and plant load factors
Medical facilities for self, spouse, children, and dependent parents in NTPC hospitals
Post-Retirement Medical Care, Contributory Provident Fund, and Gratuity
